capabilities: Launch Claude Code in the active note's parent directory via a ribbon icon
Open the current directory or vault root in Claude Code from the command palette
Copy enabled plugin settings from the vault root's .claude/settings.json into the target directory before launch
extras: macOS-only (uses AppleScript to launch Terminal); the Claude Code CLI must be installed and available in PATH.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand the current note's folder to an external terminal-based coding agent without manually navigating in Terminal.

relations.evidence: launches Claude Code in the directory of the current note or at the vault root

summary: Launcher that opens the Claude Code CLI in the active note's directory or the vault root from the ribbon or command palette.
